description: This Java class 'LoanRequestBuilders' provides static methods to construct various request objects related to loan processing, such as applying for loans, approving, disbursing, repaying, waiving, charging off, and adding chargebacks. It acts as a helper utility in integration tests to build request payloads for API calls related to loans.

classes.name: LoanRequestBuilders
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to construct various loan-related request objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: applyLoan
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansRequest for a standard individual loan application with specified parameters.

methods.name: applyCumulativeLoan
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansRequest for a cumulative loan with specified interest rate and other parameters.

methods.name: applyProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Alias for applyCumulativeLoan, constructs a progressive loan request.

methods.name: approveLoan
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdRequest to approve a loan with given amount and approval date.

methods.name: disburseLoan
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdRequest to disburse a loan with specified amount and date.

methods.name: repayLoan
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsRequest to record a loan repayment transaction.

methods.name: makeWaiver
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsRequest to record a waiver transaction.

methods.name: chargeOff
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsRequest to charge off a loan.

methods.name: addChargeback
methods.description: Constructs a PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsRequest for adding a chargeback transaction.

methods.name: waiveInterest
methods.description: Constructs a waiver transaction, alias for makeWaiver.
